description: This Java test class, MessagesRouteTest, verifies the behavior of the MessagesRoute component concerning inbox and outbox message endpoints, including claims, messages, and scenarios with slashes in subjects. It tests various HTTP methods and URL paths using a testing framework based on Akka HTTP and JUnit.

classes.name: MessagesRouteTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing MessagesRoute endpoints related to inbox and outbox message handling, including claim and message operations, with tests covering HTTP methods, URL paths, and edge cases such as slashes in subject identifiers.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up actor system, protocol adapter, and route testing objects.

methods.name: postThingsClaimMessage
methods.description: Tests posting a claim message to a thing's inbox endpoint and expects a success response.

methods.name: putThingsClaimMessageReturnsMethodNotAllowed
methods.description: Verifies that PUT method on claim message endpoint returns method not allowed.

methods.name: postThingsClaimMessageWithTimeout
methods.description: Tests posting a claim message with a timeout parameter and expects success.

methods.name: postThingsInboxMessage
methods.description: Tests posting an inbox message with a specific subject and expects success.

methods.name: postThingsInboxMessageWithSlashesInSubject
methods.description: Tests posting an inbox message where the subject contains slashes, verifying proper handling.

methods.name: putThingsInboxMessageReturnsMethodNotAllowed
methods.description: Verifies that PUT on inbox message endpoint returns method not allowed.

methods.name: postThingsOutboxMessage
methods.description: Tests posting an outbox message with a specific subject and expects success.

methods.name: postThingsOutboxMessageWithSlashesInSubject
methods.description: Tests posting an outbox message with slashes in the subject.

methods.name: putThingsOutboxMessageReturnsMethodNotAllowed
methods.description: Verifies that PUT on outbox message endpoint returns method not allowed.

methods.name: getNonExistingThingsMessagesUrl
methods.description: Tests requesting a non-existing URL returns a 404 NOT FOUND status.
